description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST ai publisher filters checknew. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Checks whether a proposed AI Publisher order returns enough current product candidates. ownerAgent: ai-publisher. Use when: Use to check candidate availability without saving an order or publishing products. Input: NewFiltersRequest. Filter.Criteria is the optional free-text product search prompt, not a literal title substring. Supplier, price, profit, Prime and tag filters apply. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns GOOD, INSUFFICIENT or BAD based on up to 50 search results. Search terms: ai publisher filters checknew. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.
